name: New York City, New York
plan_title: NYC Heat Emergency Plan (NYCEM / DOHMH), as published 2024-2026
zones_source: NYC Department of City Planning, Community Districts (59, excluding Joint Interest Areas such as parks and airports, which have no resident population)
timezone_note: New York is UTC-4 during Eastern Daylight Time, which covers the entire summer heat season. Unlike Arizona, New York does observe DST, so this offset is correct for the study window but not year-round.

department_key.DOHMH: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

strategies.1: Declare a heat emergency and open cooling centres
strategies.2: Outreach to residents at highest risk
